A '''nest-guildmaster''' was the leader of a [[nest-guild]], a social grouping among the felinoid [[Schenor]] species. [[B'karitz]] was the nest-guildmaster of the nest-guild to which [[A'kazz]] belonged.<ref name="Silent Witness" />
